# ERT Teams
## ERT Security
[bold]Called by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], with [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color] approval.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Active, confirmed hostile threats have overwhelmed station security's ability to respond. Remaining security staff are insufficient to contain or eliminate the threat, and the situation poses ongoing danger to the crew.
Must not be called during a War Declaration; the Nuclear Response Team should be called instead.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] The threat has been neutralized or sufficiently contained that security can manage without external support.
[bold]Canceled by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color].
## ERT Engineering
[bold]Called by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff733c]Chief Engineer[/color].
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Catastrophic station damage (such as structural breaches, atmospheric failure, or total power loss) cannot be addressed by available engineering staff within a reasonable timeframe, and the damage poses a direct risk to crew survival.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] Engineering staff have regained the ability to manage repairs, or the damage no longer poses an immediate threat.
[bold]Canceled by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff733c]Chief Engineer[/color].
## ERT Medical
[bold]Called by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#57b8f0]Chief Medical Officer[/color].
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] A mass casualty event has exceeded the capacity of medical staff to treat, and crew survival is at risk as a direct result.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] The medical emergency has stabilized and staff can manage remaining casualties without external support.
[bold]Canceled by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#57b8f0]Chief Medical Officer[/color].
## ERT Janitorial
[bold]Called by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#2cdb2c]Head of Personnel[/color].
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] The entire station is so messy that janitorial staff cannot clean it in a reasonable time.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] The station mess has been reduced to a level that janitorial staff can handle in a reasonable time.
[bold]Canceled by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#2cdb2c]Head of Personnel[/color].
## ERT Chaplain
[bold]Called by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color].
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Cult activity on the station cannot be handled by existing security and the chaplain.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] Cult activity has been reduced to a level that existing security and the chaplain can handle.
[bold]Canceled by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color].
## ERT CBURN
[bold]Called by any three of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], [color=#57b8f0]Chief Medical Officer[/color], or [color=#cd7ccd]Research Director[/color].
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] Code Violet is active. A biological or viral outbreak has been confirmed, and containment has failed or is at imminent risk of failure. Standard medical and security response are insufficient.
Must not be called during a War Declaration.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] The outbreak has been contained and CBURN intervention is no longer necessary.
[bold]Canceled by any three of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], [color=#57b8f0]Chief Medical Officer[/color], or [color=#cd7ccd]Research Director[/color].
## Nuclear Response Team
[bold]Called by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color].
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] A War Declaration has been made against the station.
Only available after war has been declared. Has no co-authorization time limit.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
[bold]Canceled when:[/bold] The war threat has been repelled or the situation no longer requires additional security personnel.
[bold]Canceled by:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color].
